description: Detail screen MVI + navigation integration. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared components, strings) and FEAT-002 (domain models, LiveLessonsModule stub for LessonDetailViewModel binding, HomeRoute.LessonDetail). Creates LessonDetailContract, LessonDetailViewModel, LessonDetailScreen + 5 components, updates HomeEntryProvider to handle the new route, and adds unit tests for LessonDetailViewModel.
steps: Step 1 — Detail screen MVI contract: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/detail/LessonDetailContract.kt in package ...tabs.live.presentation.detail. Contents: (a) data class LessonDetailUiState(val isLoading: Boolean = true, val lesson: LiveLesson? = null, val files: List<LessonFile> = emptyList(), val exams: List<LessonExam> = emptyList(), val error: String? = null) : MviState. (b) sealed interface LessonDetailIntent : MviIntent { data object LoadDetail; data class PreviewFile(val file: LessonFile); data class DownloadFile(val file: LessonFile); data class StartExam(val examId: String) }. (c) sealed interface LessonDetailEffect : MviEffect { data class OpenFilePreview(val url: String, val mimeType: String); data class DownloadFile(val url: String, val fileName: String); data class ShowExamSnackbar(val message: String); data class ShowError(val message: String) }.

Step 2 — Detail screen ViewModel: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/detail/LessonDetailViewModel.kt. class LessonDetailViewModel(private val lessonId: String, private val getLessonDetails: GetLessonDetailsUseCase, private val getLessonFiles: GetLessonFilesUseCase, private val getLessonExams: GetLessonExamsUseCase) : BaseMviViewModel<LessonDetailUiState, LessonDetailIntent, LessonDetailEffect>(LessonDetailUiState()). init { onIntent(LessonDetailIntent.LoadDetail) }. onIntent: LoadDetail → launch coroutine to call all 3 use cases with async{}, await() each, set state with results or error; PreviewFile → compute mimeType from file.fileType (PDF→application/pdf, DOCX→application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, PPTX→application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation, OTHER→application/octet-stream), sendEffect(OpenFilePreview(url, mimeType)); DownloadFile → sendEffect(DownloadFile(url, name)); StartExam → sendEffect(ShowExamSnackbar('Exam starting soon...'). Note: The LessonDetailViewModel binding in FEAT-002's LiveLessonsModule used a stub — this step COMPLETES that class, so the stub placeholder from FEAT-002 (if any) should be removed.

Step 3 — Detail screen components (5 files): Create in feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/detail/components/. (a) LessonInfoHeader.kt: stateless composable LessonInfoHeader(lesson: LiveLesson, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). Column: JanaStatusChip for status, title (titleLarge+Serif), subject/teacher row with School icon, JanaDateTimeLabel. (b) LessonFilesSection.kt: stateless composable LessonFilesSection(files: List<LessonFile>, onPreview: (LessonFile) -> Unit, onDownload: (LessonFile) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). JanaSectionHeader with lesson_files_title, then LazyColumn of LessonFileItem. If files empty show Text(lesson_no_files). (c) LessonFileItem.kt: stateless composable LessonFileItem(file: LessonFile, onPreview: () -> Unit, onDownload: () -> Unit). Row: JanaFileTypeIcon(file.fileType.name) on start, name + formatted size (e.g. '2.3 MB') in center column, then Preview button (OutlinedButton labeled lesson_file_preview) + Download button (FilledTonalButton labeled lesson_file_download) on end. (d) LessonExamSection.kt: stateless composable LessonExamSection(exams: List<LessonExam>, onStart: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier). JanaSectionHeader with lesson_exams_title, then list of LessonExamCard. If exams empty show Text(lesson_no_exams). (e) LessonExamCard.kt: stateless composable LessonExamCard(exam: LessonExam, onStart: (String) -> Unit). Surface(RoundedCornerShape 12dp, border OutlineVariant). Row: Quiz icon (AstralIndigo), exam title + timed/open chip (lesson_exam_timed / lesson_exam_open) + duration if timed, then Button(lesson_exam_start) on end calling onStart(exam.id).

Step 4 — Detail screen: Create feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/presentation/detail/LessonDetailScreen.kt in package ...tabs.live.presentation.detail. Stateful function LessonDetailScreen(lessonId: String, onBack: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier): val viewModel: LessonDetailViewModel = koinViewModel { parametersOf(lessonId) }. Collect state via collectAsState(). Collect effects in LaunchedEffect(viewModel): OpenFilePreview → previewFile(url, mimeType) from PlatformActions; DownloadFile → openUrl(url); ShowExamSnackbar → snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(msg); ShowError → snackbarHostState.showSnackbar(msg). Stateless function LessonDetailContent(state, onIntent, onBack, modifier): Scaffold with JanaTopBar(lesson_detail_title, onBackClick=onBack) + SnackbarHost. Body: if isLoading show CircularProgressIndicator; if error show retry Text; else LazyColumn with LessonInfoHeader, description Text (bodyMedium, padding 16dp), LessonFilesSection (passes onPreview/onDownload intents), LessonExamSection (passes onStart intent). Bottom padding 80dp.

Step 5 — Navigation wiring: Edit feature/home/src/commonMain/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/HomeEntryProvider.kt. Update the when block to handle the new route: is HomeRoute.Root → NavEntry(key) { HomeFlow() }; is HomeRoute.LessonDetail → NavEntry(key) { LessonDetailScreen(lessonId = key.lessonId, onBack = { /* handled by NavDisplay */ }) }. For the back button: inject AppNavigator via koinInject() inside the NavEntry lambda and pass onBack = { navigator.back() }.

Step 6 — Remove stub placeholder: If a stub LessonDetailViewModel placeholder class was created in FEAT-002, delete it and ensure the real class from Step 2 is the only definition. The Koin module binding `viewModel { (lessonId: String) -> LessonDetailViewModel(lessonId, get(), get(), get()) }` in LiveLessonsModule.kt should now compile cleanly against the real class.

Step 7 — Detail ViewModel unit tests: Create feature/home/src/jvmTest/kotlin/com/hussein/jana/feature/home/tabs/live/LessonDetailViewModelTest.kt following the same pattern as ScheduleTabViewModelTest. Create a FakeLessonDetailsUseCase, FakeLessonFilesUseCase, FakeLessonExamsUseCase that return pre-built mock data synchronously. Tests: initial state isLoading=true; after LoadDetail completes lesson/files/exams are populated; PreviewFile emits OpenFilePreview with correct mimeType for each LessonFileType; DownloadFile emits DownloadFile effect; StartExam emits ShowExamSnackbar.
acceptance_criteria: LessonDetailContract defines LessonDetailUiState, LessonDetailIntent, and LessonDetailEffect correctly.
LessonDetailViewModel compiles with constructor (lessonId, 3 use cases) and no Koin references in its own file.
LessonDetailScreen renders with Scaffold + JanaTopBar + back navigation.
HomeEntryProvider handles HomeRoute.LessonDetail and shows LessonDetailScreen.
LiveLessonsScreen correctly navigates to detail on OpenLessonDetail intent via AppNavigator.
